skills.description: A world-class, practical Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) workbench for marketing, brand, SEO and content teams and site owners — covering every major AI engine in China (DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, Yuanbao, Wenxin/Baidu AI Search, Quark, Nano, Metaso, Zhihu Zhida, Zhipu) and worldwide (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Google AI Overviews, Grok). Its core innovation is a zero-human-intervention self-iteration system plus the LRVP three-stage empirical verification protocol: a dual engine (Engine A monthly batch evolution + Engine B runtime real-time verification of authoritative sources) drives a six-piece self-iteration engine and a five-pillar living architecture, so GEO rules stay traceable, reviewable and fresh with no human intervention, automatically absorbing each platform's new algorithms and policies and shipping only gated output.
